lines.zh: 四片肉鳍撑着，我像在爬。
lines.en: Four fleshy fins prop me up like a crawl.

lines.zh: 我用前鳍扒住石头往前拖。
lines.en: I grip the stone with a front fin and haul myself.

lines.zh: 身体一弓一伸，我挪动了。
lines.en: My body arches and stretches and I'm moved.

lines.zh: 鳍尖压在沙上，留一排点。
lines.en: My fin tips press the sand in a line of dots.
I creep along the water's edge.
My back is heavy, so I move slowly.

lines.zh: 我用鳍试了试下一块石头。
lines.en: I test the next stone with a fin.
I work forward along the weeds.
One tail swing and I slide half a foot.

lines.zh: 这地方石头多，我挑平的踩。
lines.en: Lots of stone; I pick the flat ones.
I head for the shallows where it's easier.
The skin on my fins is thick and won't wear through.
I check the bank, then go on.

lines.zh: 我拖着身子挪过一片碎石。
lines.en: I drag myself over a patch of gravel.

lines.zh: 背鳍蹭到石头，发出一声。
lines.en: My dorsal fin scrapes stone and makes a sound.
I push forward an inch at a time.
I lie at the water's edge with all four fins spread.
My gills move slowly.
Water slides under my fins.

lines.zh: 我趴在石上，连腮都不动。
lines.en: I lie on the stone, not even gills moving.

lines.zh: 水涨一寸，我就往前挪一寸。
lines.en: An inch of tide, an inch forward.
Sunlight shows my dorsal fin half translucent.
I rest my head on a stone.
I blink twice, slowly.

lines.zh: 这个位置能上水也能上岸。
lines.en: From here I can reach both water and land.

lines.zh: 我在等下一阵水纹过来。
lines.en: I wait for the next ripple to come.
A bug has landed on my back.
I bite the air, then close my mouth.

lines.zh: 我的鳍上有细小的纹路。
lines.en: There are fine lines across my fins.
The wind wrinkles my reflection.
The water's dropped half an inch.
I slowly draw my tail in.

lines.zh: 你站的那块石头是我的路。
lines.en: The stone you're on is my path.
I lift my head to look up at you.

lines.zh: 你身上有别的水的味道。
lines.en: You smell of other water.
All four of my fins are braced.
I don't like being blocked.
One step back and I'll be past.

lines.zh: 我抬起宽嘴，朝你张了张。
lines.en: I lift my broad snout and gape at you.
My dorsal fin is harder than it looks.
There's water under your feet; it's slick.
I open my mouth and show a row of teeth.

lines.zh: 我慢慢地朝你挪了一寸。
lines.en: I creep an inch toward you.

lines.zh: 你回头看的时候，我停了。
lines.en: You looked back, so I stopped.
I recoil and pull all my fins in.

lines.zh: 背脊挨了一下，我贴回石面。
lines.en: A blow to the spine; I flatten to the stone.
I retreat a foot into the water.
Blood drips onto the stone.
My fin has been stepped on and gone white.
Mouth open, I can't get air.
I flatten down even further.
It hurts, but I haven't gone far.
I tuck my tail under me.
I've remembered your feet.

lines.zh: 那东西在沙上扑腾，我要。
lines.en: It flops on the sand; I want it.

lines.zh: 我朝着那个味道爬过去。
lines.en: I crawl toward that smell.
Put it in the water.
I'm not close enough yet.

lines.zh: 这个味道我在岸上闻过。
lines.en: I've smelled this on land before.
I stretch my head over, mouth open.
Small, but I want it anyway.
I lie here and wait for you to throw it.
The water's too shallow here for me.
One gulp and I back away.
Throw another one over.
I go along following that hint of blood.

lines.zh: 你手再低些，我就够到了。
lines.en: Lower your hand and I can reach.
I've reached the edge of your boot.
I'm quicker than you'd think.
It's jumping in my mouth.

lines.zh: 我抽回鳍，在沙上蹭了蹭。
lines.en: I pull my fin back and rub it in the sand.
I back into the water to steady myself.

lines.zh: 这一撞，我的鳍滑了一下。
lines.en: That knock made my fin slip.
The stone edge is too narrow.
I drag myself aside to let you pass.

lines.zh: 你压得我四片鳍都弯了。
lines.en: You bent all four of my fins.

lines.zh: 我身上的水蹭到你腿上了。
lines.en: My wet body smeared your leg.
I flatten out and stop moving.

lines.zh: 这一下把我们两个都挤住了。
lines.en: That wedged both of us.
I slowly angled away.

lines.zh: 另一条从我侧面爬过来。
lines.en: Another one crawls up on my flank.

lines.zh: 我们的鳍碰在一起，很硬。
lines.en: Our fins knock together, hard.
I turn side-on so it can lean in.

lines.zh: 水边的石头刚好够两个。
lines.en: This stone at the water's edge fits two.

lines.zh: 我们一起把头抬向水面。
lines.en: We lift our heads toward the surface together.
It touches my tail with a fin.
The tide is rising; we're in no hurry.
I closed my mouth.
This shoal is very quiet.
It won't leave before dawn.
I snap up that fish.
I sweep the thing over with a fin.

lines.zh: 它卡在石缝里，我够不着。
lines.en: It's stuck in a crevice; I can't reach.
This stone weighs more than I do.
I press it under my tongue.
Too small; it slipped out.
I pin it and look it over.

lines.zh: 金属味在嘴里散开，我吐了。
lines.en: Metal taste spreads; I spit it out.
I spit it out; it isn't food.
I bury it in the sand with a fin.
There are footsteps by the water.
I press my head down onto the stone.

lines.zh: 我四片鳍一撑，对准了它。
lines.en: I brace on four fins and aim.
That thing is too close to the water.
Four fins brace; I'm ready to lunge.
I've picked its ankle.
Its shadow reaches toward me.
I hold my breath.

lines.zh: 这里的水很浅，我够得到。
lines.en: The water's shallow here; I can reach.
I wait for it to come half a foot closer.
I crawl forward an inch at a time.
It looks back, so I stop.
I creep along the stone.

lines.zh: 水纹把我的动作掩住了。
lines.en: The ripples hide my movement.
Its foot is at the stone's edge.
One foot of ground left.
I draw my tail in, coiled.
It hasn't heard my fins.

lines.zh: 我挑了一个能借力的点。
lines.en: I've picked a spot to push off from.

lines.zh: 差一片鳍的距离，我就扑。
lines.en: One fin's length more and I lunge.
I lunge in one motion.
My teeth clamp on its foot.

lines.zh: 我连鳍带身一起砸下去。
lines.en: Fins and body crash down together.
My tail sweeps it into the water.
That bite went deep.

lines.zh: 它摔在浅水里，水花很大。
lines.en: It falls into the shallows, splashing hard.
I release and back off half a foot.
My fins slip on the stone.
It tore loose, trailing blood.
I flatten out and wait for the next chance.
I crawl out of the water onto the bank.

lines.zh: 四片鳍第一次撑住我的身体。
lines.en: Four fins take my weight for the first time.
My first breath tastes of stone.
I lie there and look around first.
The water is right behind me.
My dorsal fin isn't spread yet.
The light up here is harsh.
I lift my head, then lower it.
Something's walking far off.
I creep slowly toward the water's edge.

lines.zh: 火烤着我的鳍，皮都卷了。
lines.en: Fire scorches my fins and the skin curls.
I fall off the stone into the shallows.
Water floods my mouth and I can't break free.

lines.zh: 石屑和冲击一起掀翻我。
lines.en: Shards and blast flip me over together.
An arrow passes through my dorsal fin.

lines.zh: 一股烫意在我血里游走。
lines.en: A burning runs through my blood.
Too hungry for my fins to hold me up.
Lightning lands on my soaked body.
There's no bottom left in the water.
